title: Kanban delivery
description: Workflow policies, work in progress and flow metrics for a team managing continuous demand.

rules.instruction: Agree where a work item starts and finishes, which policies govern movement and how the team will control work in progress.
rules.verification: Select an item in each state and ask its owner to show why the item entered that state and which capacity policy applies.

rules.instruction: When work in progress reaches the agreed limit, ask the team lead which item to finish or unblock before a new one starts, and record any exception with its cause.
rules.verification: Compare actual item counts with the team's limits and check that each exception has a recorded cause.

rules.instruction: Compute cycle time, work in progress, throughput and work item age from the board's movement records.
rules.verification: Recompute the measures from a sample of movement records and compare them with the team's report.

rules.instruction: Estimate a service level expectation from the cycle times of completed items and record it with the workflow definition.
rules.verification: Recompute the expectation from the completed items of the stated period.

rules.instruction: Flag active items whose age approaches the service level expectation and record what the team did about each.
rules.verification: For a sample of items that passed the expectation, find the recorded action or the reason none was taken.
